title: Planning a school reunion
instructions: Eski okul arkadaşları buluşma düzenliyor. Uzun bir diyalog; tarih, yer, kişi sayısı ve görevleri takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Kerem, it's been fifteen years since we finished school. Let's organise a reunion!

script.speaker: a
script.text: What about the last Saturday in June? Most people are on holiday in July.

script.speaker: b
script.text: OK. Where shall we have it?

script.speaker: a
script.text: The school said we can use the hall for free, but there's no kitchen.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Then let's book a restaurant. There's a nice one by the sea that has a private room for fifty people.

script.speaker: a
script.text: How many people were in our year?

script.speaker: b
script.text: About eighty, but I think maybe forty will come.

script.speaker: a
script.text: OK. I'll create a group online and find everyone's contact details.

script.speaker: b
script.text: And I'll call the restaurant tomorrow to ask about prices.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Let's ask people to pay by the end of May.

questions.prompt: How long ago did they finish school?
questions.feedback: Okulu on beş yıl önce bitirdiler.
questions.evidence: it's been fifteen years since we finished school.
